svg.title: Binit echoes keys 133–389× sooner than ble.sh and as fast as plain Readline
svg.desc: Typing a character, slowest 1 in 100 keystrokes (p99): vs ble.sh, 133–146× faster (Binit 0.20–0.21 ms · ble.sh 27.5–29.1 ms, scored); vs plain Readline, about the same, 0.98–1.20× (Binit 0.20–0.21 ms · Readline 0.20–0.24 ms, reported). Deleting a character, slowest 1 in 100 keystrokes (p99): vs ble.sh, 344–389× faster (Binit 0.21–0.25 ms · ble.sh 83.2–84.8 ms, scored); vs plain Readline, about the same, 0.91–1.04× (Binit 0.21–0.25 ms · Readline 0.21–0.23 ms, reported).
